spans.s:
अध अध or अधा, ind., Ved. (much the
same as अथ, used chiefly as an inceptive particle),
now; then, therefore; moreover, so much the more;
and, partly.
—अध-अध, अस् well as, partly-partly.
—अध-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, or अध-प्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ,
Ved. pleased or glad then.
अधा अधा, Ved. See अध.

आधा आ-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते,
-धातुम्, to place, deposit, apply, appoint, direct,
propose, supply, give, make, constitute; (only A.) to
appropriate to one's self, hold, possess, take.
अधः अधः, &c. See अधस्।

अधन अ-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of
wealth or property.

आ-धान, अम्, n. putting near or upon, placing;
taking, having; receiving, recovering; the containing
anything, the being in possession of a thing; a cere-
mony performed with consecrated fire (see अग्न्या-
धान); a ceremony performed previous to concep-
tion (see गर्भाधान); a pledge, a deposit; a
surety; assigning, attributing, employing; the place
in which anything is deposited or rests; a receptacle;
enclosure, circuit.

अ-धन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not richly supplied with corn
or other produce; not prosperous; unhappy, wretched.

अधम अधम, अस्, आ, अम् (see etymology of
अधर), lowest, vilest, worst; very low or vile or
bad; often used at the close of comp., as in नरा-
धम, the vilest or worst of men; (अस्), an un-
blushing paramour; (आ), a low or bad mistress [cf. Lat.
infimus].
—अधम-भृत or अधम-भृतक,
अस्, m. a servant of the lowest class, a porter.
—अधमर्ण (˚म-ऋ˚), अस्, or अधमर्णिक,
अस्, m. one reduced to inferiority by debt, a debtor.
—अधम-शाख, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), N.
of a region.
—अधमाङ्ग (˚म-अङ्˚), अम्, n. (the
lowest member), the foot.
—अधमाचार (˚म-आच्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, guilty of vile conduct.
—अधमार्ध
(˚म-अर्˚), अम्, n. the lower half, the lower part.
—अधमार्ध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, connected with or
referring to the lower part.

अधमर्णा, अधमर्णिक, &c. See above, under
अधम.

अधर अधर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to come
from अधस् or from a base अध्, whence अधस्
may be derived), lower, inferior; tending down-
wards; low, vile; worsted, silenced; prior; (अस्),
m. the lower lip, the lip; (आ), f. the lower re-
gion, nadir; (अम्), n. the lower part; a reply;
Pudendum Muliebre [Ossetic, दलग्; Goth. dala-
thrô; Lat. inferus].
—अधर-तस् or अधर-
स्तात् or अधरस्मात् or अधरात् or अधरेण, ind.
below, beneath; in the lower region.
—अधर-
कण्ठ, अस्, अम्, m. n. the lower neck.
—अधर-
काय, अस्, m. the lower part of the body.
—अधर-
पान, अम्, n. drinking the lower lip, kissing.
—अधर-मधु, उ, n. the moisture of the lips.
—अधर-स्वस्तिक, अम्, n. the nadir.
—अधरा-
मृत (˚र-अम्˚), अम्, n. the nectar of the lips.
—अधरारणि (˚र-अर्˚), इस्, f., Ved. the lower of
the two pieces of wood used in producing fire by
friction.
—अधरावलोप (˚र-अव्˚), अस्, m. biting
the lip.
—अधरोत्तर (˚र-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, lower
and higher; worse and better; question and answer;
nearer and further; sooner and later; upside down,
topsy-turvy.
—अधरोष्ठ or अधरौष्ठ (˚र-
ओष्˚), अस्, m. the lower lip; (अम्), n. the lower and
upper lip.
आधार आ-धार. See under आ-धृ.

आ-धार, अस्, m. support, prop, stay; the power of
sustaining, or the support given, aid, patronage, as-
sistance; that which contains; a vessel or receptacle;
a dike, dam; a canal; a basin round the foot of a
tree; comprehension, location, the sense of the loca-
tive case; relation.
—आधाराधेय-भाव (˚र-
आध्˚), अस्, m. the influence or action of the support
or recipient upon the thing received or supported.
अधराक्, ind. beneath, in the lower region.

अधराचीन or अधराच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, or
अधराञ्च् आङ्, आची, आक्, Ved. tending downwards, to
the nadir or the lower region, tending towards the
south (or west ?).
अधरात्तात्, ind., Ved. below, beneath.
अधरी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, worsted; invalidated.
अधरीण, अस्, आ, अम्, vilified.
अधरी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, worsted; invalidated.

अधरे-द्युस्, ind. the day before yesterday; on a
previous day.
अधरेय, अस्, आ, अम्, inferior in quality or worth.

अधर्म अ-धर्म, अस्, m. unrighteousness,
injustice, irreligion, wickedness; demerit, guilt; N. of
a Prajāpati, son of Brahmā, husband of Hiṃsā or
Mṛṣā; N. of an attendant of the sun; (आ), f. un-
righteousness personified and represented as the bride
of death.
—अधर्म-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, practising
wickedness.
—अधर्म-तस्, ind. unrighteously, un-
justly.
—अधर्म-दण्डन, अम्, n. unjust punish-
[]
ment.
—अधर्म-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made up of
wickedness; downright wicked.
—अधर्मात्मन्
(˚म-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, having a wicked spirit or dis-
position.
—अधर्मास्तिकाय (˚म-अस्˚), अस्, m. the
category (अस्तिकाय) of अधर्म.
अधर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, unrighteous, wicked, impious.
अधर्मिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, most wicked, impious.

अधर्म्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unlawful, contrary to law
or religion, wicked.

अधवा अ-धवा, f. a widow (usually वि-
धवा, without a husband).

आ-धाव, अस्, m., Ved. that which is shaken or
cleansed by shaking.

अधस् अधस्, ind. (said to come from अध्,
see अधर), below, down; in the lower region;
beneath, under; from under (with acc., gen., and abl.);
also applied to the lower region and to the Pudendum
Muliebre [cf. Lat. infra].
—अधस्-तरम्, ind. very
far down.
—अध-उपासन, अम्, n. sexual inter-
course.
—अधः-कर, अस्, m. the lower part of the
hand.
—अधः-काय, अस्, m. the lower part of the body.
—अधः-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, put down, cast down.
—अधः-कृष्णाजिनम् (˚ण-अज्˚), ind. under the
black skin.
—अधः-खनन, अम्, n. undermin-
ing.
—अधः-पद्म, अम्, n. (in architecture) a cer-
tain part of the cupola.
—अधः-पात, अस्, m. a down-
fall.
—अधः-पुष्पी, f. (having flowers looking
downwards), N. of two plants, Pimpinella Anisum
and Elephantopus Scaber (or Hieracium ?).
—अधः-
प्रवाह, अस्, m. a downward current.
—अधः-
प्रस्तर, अस्, m. seat or bed of turf or grass for
person in a state of impurity.
—अधः-प्राङ्-शायिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, sleeping on the ground, towards the east.
—अधश्-चर, अस्, m. a thief (‘creeping on the
ground’).
—अधः-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping on the
ground.
—अधः-शय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having a pecu-
liar couch on the ground; (आ), f. act of sleeping on
the ground and on a peculiar couch.
—अधः-शिरस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, holding the head downward; head fore-
most; (अस्), n., N. of a hell.
—अधस्-तल, अम्, n.
the room below anything.
—अधस्-पद, अम्, n.
the place under the feet.
—अधस्पदम्, ind. under
foot.
—अधः-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, placed low or below;
inferior.
—अधः-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, standing below;
situated below.
—अधः-स्वस्तिक, अम्, n. the nadir.
—अधो-ऽंशुक, अम्, n. a lower garment.
—अधो-
ऽक्ष or अधो-अक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (situated) below
the axle or under a car; (अम्), ind. under the axle.
—अधो-ऽक्ष-ज, अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu or
Kṛṣṇa; the sign Śravaṇā.
—अधो-गण्टा, f. a plant,
Achyranthes Aspera.
—अधो-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone
down, descended.
—अधो-गति, इस्, f. or अधो-गम, अस्,
m. or अधो-गमन, अम्, n. descent, downward move-
ment, degradation.
—अधो-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, going down-
wards, descending.
—अधो-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ = preced-
ing.
—अधो-घण्टा, f. a plant, Achyranthes Aspera.
—अधो-ऽङ्ग, अम्, n. the anus, Pudendum Muli-
ebre.
—अधो-जानु, ind. below the knee.
—अधो-
जिह्विका, f. the uvula.
—अधो-दारु, उ, n. the under
timber.
—अधो-दिश्, क्, f. the lower region, the nadir.
—अधो-दृष्टि, इस्, f. a downcast look; (इस्, इस्, इ),
having a downcast look.
—अधो-देश, अस्, m. the
lower or lowest part, especially of the body.
—अधो-
द्वार, अम्, n. the anus, Pudendum Muliebre.
—अधो-नाभम्, ind. below the navel.
—अधो-
ऽपर, अम्, n. the anus.
—अधोपहास (˚धस्-उप्˚),
अस्, m., Ved. sexual intercourse.
—अधो-बन्धन,
अम्, n. an under girth.
—अधो-भक्त, अम्, n. a
dose of medicine to be taken after eating.
—अधो-
भव, अस्, आ, अम्, lower.
—अधो-भाग, अस्, m. the
lower or lowest part, especially of the body.
—अधो-
भाग-दोष-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, curing or strengthen-
ing the lower part of the body.
—अधो-भुवन,
अम्, n. the lower world.
—अधो-भूमि, इस्, f. lower
ground; land at the foot of a hill.
—अधो-मर्मन्,
अ, n. the anus.
—अधो-मुख, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, having
the face downwards; headlong; upside down; (अस्),
m. Viṣṇu; (आ), f. a plant, Premna Esculenta; (अम्),
n. a division of hell.
—अधो-यन्त्र, अम्, n. the
lower part of an apparatus; a still.
—अधो-रक्त-
पित्त, अम्, n. discharge of blood from the anus and the
urethra.
—अधो-राम, अस्, m., Ved. (a goat) having
[]
peculiar white or black marks on the lower part of
the body.
—अधो-लाम्ब, अस्, m. a plummet; the
perpendicular; (अस्), m. the lower world.
—अधो-
वदन, अस्, आ, अम्, the same as अधो-मुख.
—अधो-वर्चस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, powerful in the lower
regions.
—अधो-वश, अस्, m. the bottom, Pudendum
Muliebre.
—अधो-वायु, उस्, m. vital air passing down-
wards; flatulency.
—अधो-ऽवेक्षि (अधस् + अव +
ईक्षिन्), looking down.
—अधो-ऽश्र-पित्त, see अधो-
रक्तपित्त.
—अधो-ऽश्वम्, ind. under the horse.
अधस्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, lower, being underneath.
अधस्तात्, ind. the same as अधस्, q. v.
अधस्ताद्-दिश्, क्, f. the lower region, the nadir.

अधामार्गव अधामार्गव, अस्, m. a plant,
Achyranthes Aspera.

अधारणक अ-धारणक, अस्, आ, अम्, unable
to support, unremunerative.

अधार्मिक अ-धार्मिक, अस्, ई, अम्, unjust,
unrighteous, wicked.

आधर्मिक आधर्मिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अ-धर्म),
unjust, unrighteous.

अधार्य अ-धार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unfit or improper
to be held or carried or kept up.

आ-धार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be located, that to which
a location is to be assigned.
—आधार्याधार-सम्-
बन्ध, अस्, m. the relation of the recipient or recep-
tacle and the thing to be received or located.

आधमर्ण्य आधमर्ण्य, अम्, n. (fr. अध-
मर्ण), the state of being indebted.
आधर्षण आ-धर्षण. See आ-धृष्.

आ-धर्षण, अम्, n. conviction of crime or error;
sentence, refutation; injuring, annoying.

आधानिक, अम्, n. a ceremony performed after
cohabitation to procure or favour conception.
आ-धाय, ind. having deposited or placed.

आ-धायक, अस्, इका, अम्, placing, assigning, attri-
buting, applying.

आधाव् आ-धाव्, cl. 1. P. -धावति, -वितुम्,
to come running, to run towards.

आ-धावमान, अस्, आ, अम्, running, rushing on-
wards or at.
आ-धवन, अम्, n. agitating, moving.

आ-धवनीय, अस्, m. a vessel in which the Soma
plant is shaken and cleansed.
आ-धारक, अस्, m. foundation.
आ-धारण, अम्, n. bearing, holding, supporting.

आ-धर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, convicted, sentenced;
refuted in argument, disproved, injured, aggrieved.

अधः-क्रिया, f. = अप-मान, disgrace, humilia-
tion.

अधर-कण्ठ; add — the lower part of the
throat.

अधरय, Nom. P. अधरयति, &c., to make
inferior, put under; to eclipse, excel.
